name: tincan
description: End-to-end encrypted live text sharing from one sender to one receiver.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tincan/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @tincan/shared" "npm run dev -w @tincan/server" "npm run dev -w @tincan/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tincan/shared && npm run build -w @tincan/client && npm run build -w @tincan/server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve -w @tincan/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tincan/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
